text:
Lina: Kickoff for OSS 'Harbor' refapp launch — deliverables: quickstart tutorial, reproducible benchmark blog, 30m livestream demo, and HubSpot inbound form. Aim: 3-week ship. Thoughts? :anchor:

Ethan: Love the name. Bench should highlight: cold-start p95, steady-state p99, and token-cost per 1k for a customer FAQ flow. Make scripts runnable locally.

Priya: I'll write the 6-step tutorial. Need a single-file example and Docker snippet that just works. Suggest node example hitting Redwood API and a one-liner to switch to Dedicated.

Design-Bot: Can produce a 5s hero GIF + a simple architecture SVG. ETA 48h. Prefer 640x360 for socials.

Marco: Webinar plan: 8m intro, 15m demo (recorded fallback), 5m bench highlights, 2m CTA/Qs. Demo should include a canned transcript to avoid surprises.

Ethan: I'll own the bench harness. Example run: `./bench/run.sh --model small-q4 --prompts prompts/faqs.json --qps 30 --duration 240` and publish /bench/results/*.csv. Include hardware and model flags.

Priya: Repo layout: /quickstart, /bench, /docs. README Docker snippet: `FROM node:18-slim ... CMD ["node","index.js"]` and `redwood serve --model small-q4` in examples.

Lina: Inbound: HubSpot form + UTM params utm_source=community utm_campaign=harbor_launch. Hidden field deployment_interest (hosted/dedicated/private). Tag leads with "harbor-refapp".

Marco: Social snippets and landing copy needed. CTA -> HubSpot. Add GA event 'harbor_cta'.

Ethan: Also include a KV cache mini-benchmark to show token savings; chart in blog. I'll produce synthetic before/after CSV.

Priya: CI: tiny GH Action to run a smoke bench on push and upload artifact. Workflow small so it doesn't cost much.

Lina: Timeline: Week0 scaffold + tutorial, Week1 bench + blog draft, Week2 record + rehearsals + social assets, Week3 launch + livestream + followups. I'll assign tasks in Asana.

Design-Bot: Will drop mockups and GIF links here when ready.

Marco: I'll coordinate rehearsal slots and record the fallback demo. Need staging access — can someone open infra ticket?

Lina: Good start. Owners: Priya (tutorial/repo), Ethan (bench), Marco (demo/webinar), Design (assets), Lina (coord). Reconvene Friday for status. :thumbsup:
